note: USACE Kanopolis Lake campground spread over an open, lightly treed headland on the east shore below sandstone bluffs; several loops reach the shoreline, the rest sit on the upland behind. --Claude
summary: rec.gov 233659: 118 reservable sites (non-electric $18, electric $22, 50 A W/E $24, May-Sep tables), max 65 ft, showers, flush/vault toilets, dump; weekend 2 / holiday 3 minimums, 14-night cap. Waterfront: lakeview -> LAKEFRONT proposed on a per-site check (D24-D28, K05-K07, A17-A18 open to the water). Stored max 80 ft corrected to 65.
flags: WATERFRONT UPGRADE PROPOSED (apply.py doesn't write it): stored lakeview -> LAKEFRONT. Per-site check, rec.gov coordinates on Esri imagery: D24, D25, D26, D28 (non-electric) sit ~15-30 m from the south-tip shore across open mown grass with only a post fence at the edge; K05-K07 (50 A electric) ~25-40 m from the rocky west shore across open grass, no road between; A17-A18 (30 A) at the bluff edge ~15-25 m above the shore with scattered trees. Not confirmed: A16, A29, B14, B20 (40-80 m, scrub), D10, D35, E08D, E10 (east shore, ~30-50 m through trees). So about 9 of 118 sites are lakefront by the open-apron rule (rec.gov tags 18 'Lakefront', a claim); the C and E loops and most of A/B/D are upland lakeview or no view. Lake level fluctuates (exposed sand/rock apron at the imagery date). If AWH prefers the bulk value, lakeview stays.

Stored waterfront_evidence ("RV finger-pad loops on open upland 150-400m from the lake") was a whole-park read; per the brief it may share the 2084 Horsethief mix-up, so it is replaced by the per-site read above rather than reused.
